title: FacilityStateBatch
description: EWDS Topic schema for Client Gateway payload validation. Batch of state snapshots (int:FacilityState) for multiple Facilities, all belonging to the same Site, mirroring the FacilityMeasurement schema's hierarchy.

siteId.description: FK to the Site that all Facilities in this batch belong to.

items.description: State snapshots for one Facility within the batch.

facilityId.description: FK to the Facility these state snapshots belong to.

items.description: A single state snapshot for a Facility (int:FacilityState).

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the state is recorded. ISO 8601 with timezone.

occupancy.description: The number of occupants in the facility/building.

operationalMode.description: Operational mode of the facility. NOTE: pending TUM confirmation per the ontology workbook; not yet explicitly present in any partner file.
